text: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD.
Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the LORD.

versions.text: Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the LORD.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew phrase literally reads "lift up your hands (in/to) holiness," which can refer either to the holy place or to the manner of lifting the hands. A brief footnote preserves the ambiguity without disturbing the smooth reading of the main text.

footnotes.text: The Hebrew may also be read "lift up your hands in holiness," that is, with hands set apart for the LORD.

text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
